Terrible customer support. The package arrived damaged and two weeks late. Nobody replied to my support tickets.

The food was completely bland and overpriced. The waiter was rude and kept forgetting our orders.
The smartphone interface is okay, nothing special compared to last year's model.

Horrible experience. The app crashes every time I try to complete the checkout process.
